headline: AfDB Reports Zambia GDP Grew 5.2% in 2025 as Deficit Persists
summary: Zambia's economic growth accelerated to 5.2% in 2025 from 3.8% in 2024 led by mining, agriculture, and exports, though the country still faces a $5.4 billion financing gap, according to the African Development Bank.
why: Zambia is Africa's second-largest copper producer. Its post-debt-restructuring macroeconomic trajectory is closely tracked by frontier sovereign debt investors.

impacts.name: Zambia
impacts.why: Stronger GDP expansion of 5.2% improves macroeconomic recovery prospects despite financing deficits.
